privileged_info_for_vlm: The portal is at http://localhost:8000. It requires a User-Agent containing 'MSIE' or 'Trident' to bypass the block. The Manifest Code follows the pattern MFST-XXXX-XXXX. The final output must be saved to /home/ga/Desktop/manifest_code.txt.
